methodology: Empirical field verification combined with B2B electronic catalog extraction across Inezgane and the Souss-Massa industrial axis.

market_findings.tax_dynamics: Cash-and-carry markets in Inezgane operate predominantly on net cash basis (often HT equivalent without formal billing unless requested at +20% TVA). Refurbished computer hardware is treated as VAT-exempt second-hand goods under Moroccan tax rules.
market_findings.geographic_hub_reality: Inezgane functions as a retail-facing wholesale exchange, while the actual heavy logistics stock for computing and networking resides 4 km away in Zone Industrielle Tassila (Dcheira/Aït Melloul).
